last_completed_unit.result: Cargo documents that cargo vendor creates a local directory containing the crates.io and git dependency sources, prints the Cargo configuration needed to use those vendored sources, and treats vendored sources as read-only. Its example redirects the generated configuration into a Cargo config file. This supports reuse-time local source selection once the exact vendor tree and generated configuration already exist. The same documentation states that --offline prevents network access, but no Cargo execution was performed. Initial vendor population/provenance without network, richer-mode execution, or user execution remains unresolved.
